text: Whether hyperplasia occurs in humans using traditional training protocols remains controversial. A meta-analysis on the topic of 17 studies meeting inclusion criteria concluded that a stretch overload consistently produced greater fiber counts, and exercise-based protocols produced highly inconsistent results (103).
